scope: Native PST component values, package identities, physical pins, nets and explicit NC; comparison against requirements and every pin of the original user-saved snapshot.
comparisonPolicy: Values and footprint names compare case-insensitively; reference designators, physical pin numbers and net names compare exactly; PST NC maps to JSON null and explicit snapshot nc=1.

sourceFileObservation.note: Original source and saved snapshot still have identical SHA-256.
